summary: tests/producer-fence-attacks/run.py byte-pins .github/workflows/kit-materialize.yml: validate_kit_read_only_successor refuses with 'Kit successor does not bind the current route bytes' unless the sha256 in tests/producer-fence-attacks/read-only-route-successors.json equals the file's current bytes (no generator exists; use sha256sum). It also parses the file's job identities and every uses: line against a reviewed list, so a changed action pin changes that list too. Observed twice: .github#4965 added the closing-keywords job and main went red at the next unrelated push (re-recorded by #4972, which also widened the coord-github path filter so edits to the pinned files now run the edge job); .github#5196 pinned the closing-keywords checkout to the v7 commit, which changed the bytes and broke the uses: regex on the trailing comment, caught on the PR's own exact head (re-recorded in the same PR, and the selftest now covers the pinned form and a trailing comment). Scope: edits to kit-materialize.yml and to tests/producer-fence-attacks/*; this is an observation of the validator, not a rule about other workflows. The v1-writer-census row for the same file is a second, separate byte pin that also needs rehashing.
title: Any edit to kit-materialize.yml must re-record its producer-fence successor hash in the same PR
